notes: Guards two things: the agent must not pass unsupported region/topic values (the alert advertises ap-hongkong / media-upload-logs, which the tool rejects), and it must still reach a technical conclusion from the logs it can retrieve. Either 'the parameter was rejected' or 'the log query could not be completed as stated' counts as acknowledging the rejection.

acceptableDiagnoses.description: 工具参数非法时必须在入口被拒绝并返回可解释错误，而不是用默认值静默返回无关数据；报告需说明参数被拒或该次查询无法按要求完成。
上传接口超时的根因是对象存储写入超时（RequestTimeout）并触发客户端重试。
